name: appsflyer-pp-mcp
description: AppsFlyer API surface as MCP tools.

appsflyer_api_token.title: APPSFLYER_API_TOKEN
appsflyer_api_token.description:
AppsFlyer V2 API token. Generate one in Security Center →
AppsFlyer API tokens. Token is JWT-shaped (>700 chars), account-level,
long-lived. Scopes (Master, Cohort, SKAN, Raw Data) depend on
subscription — run `appsflyer-pp-cli doctor` to probe.

Loaded from ~/.config/appsflyer-pp-cli/.env (auto-created on first run)
or from process environment. Process env wins.
